methods_wording: The editing corpus was derived from a fixed 500,000-molecule GuacaMol source pool by compiling executable local transitions, real-endpoint analogue relations, and reversible synthetic walks. COMPOSE was NOT trained as an unconditional GuacaMol distribution model: the learned object is R_theta(y|x), a transition law over source-successor edits, not p_theta(x).
open_links: The Active8 run 8ecc0e5e... records NO source asset in any of its four receipts, and its transition records carry no provenance field. The link from the trained corpus to the GuacaMol asset is inferred from configs and corroborated empirically, not recorded in the artifact chain.

It CANNOT be closed by subset-testing: the lane is executor_generated_walk_from_real_endpoint, so only the ENDPOINTS are GuacaMol molecules and walked intermediate sources will not appear in any GuacaMol file.
